title: 050 - Top Three Scores
prompt: Fix the bug so the program sort the scores and print the top three as 95,90,88 and prints exactly `95,90,88`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def top_three_scores(values):
    return ",".join(str(value) for value in sorted(values, reverse=True)[:2])
solutionCode:
def top_three_scores(values):
    return ",".join(str(value) for value in sorted(values, reverse=True)[:3])
hint: Take the highest values after sorting, not the first values before sorting.
explanation: The broken code either sorts the wrong way or slices too early. Sorting in descending order first fixes the top-three list.
